sceneHint: SHORT RULES · OPEN QUESTIONS · PUBLICATION BOUNDARIES

notes.label: relative activation, not force
notes.copy: Normalized sEMG can support comparisons against an individual reference. It does not directly measure mechanical muscle force.
notes.detail: Use the smallest claim the evidence can carry.

notes.label: keep the null result
notes.copy: Principle frequency did not appear to predict agreement in the current models. Similarity and relevance are still under investigation.

notes.label: show which objective moved
notes.copy: A faster mechanism is not automatically fairer or more satisfactory. Track automation, efficiency, fairness, and preference outcomes separately.
notes.detail: One score can hide the argument.

notes.label: prototype ≠ validated product
notes.copy: The Shanghai map had category and 5/10/15-minute filters, but no formal user testing. Describe design intent, not proven impact.
notes.detail: Build the test before writing the success story.

notes.label: explain the work, not the proprietary screen
notes.copy: For internship material, show responsibility, architecture, and safe outcomes. Keep internal workflows, defects, credentials, and unreleased interfaces out.
